name: draftgate-demo-video
description: The README's demo, rendered with Remotion from the review window's own components. A dev tool: not a dependency, not in the plugin tree, installed only by `bun install` in this directory. Remotion is source-available and free for individuals; a contributor at a company of four or more people needs a Remotion licence to re-render.

scripts.demo: bun request.ts && remotion render src/index.ts Demo dist/demo.mp4
scripts.gif: bun request.ts && remotion render src/index.ts Demo ../../docs/demo.gif --codec=gif --scale=0.5 --every-nth-frame=3
